transformEvidence.finding: The official cZ asset loader creates a gsplat entity and applies setLocalEulerAngles(0,0,180) for SOG/PLY, except LCC2 uses270X and SPZ is unrotated. source.captureDescription:
Test 2 — Utlida

Captured area: ~2,350 m²
Structures: 2 cottages + 1 garage
Weather: Cloudy
Current coverage: ~65%

Capture

Images: 1,038

Aerial: DJI Mini 5 Pro
Ground: Panasonic Lumix S1R

Gaussian Splat

Training: 100,000 iterations

This is the second capture test of Utlida 1:80, combining aerial and ground-based photography to create a large-scale Gaussian Splat of the property and its surroundings.

Next step

The next iteration will aim for 100% capture coverage, together with GIS and measurement control to achieve the most accurate real-world scale and spatial alignment possible.

Attribution is required

3D capture and Gaussian Splat by Jakob Safwan / Overblick Studio
overblickstudio.se

If this model is used in a public project, demo, application, video, publication, website or other published work, please clearly credit the original 3D capture to Jakob Safwan / www.overblickstudio.se
